definitions.explanation: A man-made structure or building, especially one of significant size or permanence.

examples.japanese: {歴史的|れきしてき}{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要文化財|じゅうようぶんかざい}→重要文化財：14689_juuyoubunkazai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This structure has been designated as a nationally important cultural property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{損壊|そんかい}し、⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: Many structures were damaged in the earthquake, and recovery is expected to take several years.

notes:
A formal term for structures and buildings, composed of ⟦{建造|けんぞう}→建造：22998_kenzou⟧ (construction, building) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing). Frequently appears in legal, architectural, and cultural heritage contexts. More formal and literary than ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史的|れきしてき}{建造物|けんぞうぶつ} — historic structure
- ⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧{建造物|けんぞうぶつ} — wooden structure
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{建造物|けんぞうぶつ} — large-scale structure
- {建造物|けんぞうぶつ}{等|とう}⟦{放火|ほうか}→放火：18983_houka⟧ — arson of buildings (legal term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ — building; the everyday, general-purpose word
- ⟦{建築物|けんちくぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧ — architectural structure; very close in meaning but emphasizes the architectural/design aspect
- {構造物|こうぞうぶつ} — engineered structure; broader, including bridges, dams, and other civil engineering works
